profile.name: MD Shoaib Khan
profile.subtitle: Full Stack Developer
profile.description: I build accessible, pixel-perfect, and performant web experiences. Turning ideas into real-life products is my calling.

text: I'm a Full Stack Developer who helps businesses and founders turn ideas into reliable, user-friendly digital products. I focus on clean design, solid engineering, and building solutions that work well long after launch.

With experience across React, Next.js, Node.js, and cloud deployment, I deliver websites and web applications that are fast, accessible, and easy to maintain. I work closely with clients from planning to delivery — so every project is clear, on track, and built to meet real business goals.
Whether you need a new product from scratch, improvements to an existing app, or smart AI features integrated the right way, I'm here to help you ship with confidence.

experience.description: Building scalable web apps, AI integrations, and cloud deployments for clients worldwide using React, Next.js, Node.js, and AWS.
Designed and developed responsive websites and REST APIs for startups and agencies. Improved performance, SEO, and user experience across client projects.
Created pixel-perfect UIs from Figma designs, implemented modern JavaScript frameworks, and collaborated remotely with design and backend teams.
